evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC synchronization logic in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a race condition in `scantxoutset` that can permanently wedge the endpoint until the node is restarted. As described, overlapping calls can cause a new caller to throw an exception while acquiring the reservation, leaving the node reporting "Scan already in progress" on all subsequent calls.
